name: 95020 · Gilroy, CA
findings: ZIP 95020 (Gilroy) has 185 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95020 (Gilroy) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
